messages:
nina: Quick sync 1: want to run a community hacknight + 3-part mini tutorial series tied to the OSS quickstart. goal: get repo stars, drive webinar signups, and create 3 short HowTos. timeline = 4 weeks. thoughts? :seedling:
omar: love it. I can shepherd the HowTos. propose topics: 1) local dev & run, 2) cost-tuned inference, 3) embedding + search. each ~800-1200 words + 2 code snippets.
leigh: I can build the benchmark postcard (small visual + 1-liner) for social and the blog hero. need a canonical command and a simple graph. can we standardize on single-model baseline (gpt-small) and one optimized config?
taylor: I can do the webinar landing page + email drip and handle lead routing. prefer 30-minute live hacknight demo (hands-on) on a Tues evening. Routing: send leads to CRM and create a Zap to post top companies to #sales-inbound. add hidden field for company domain so we can auto-tag.
pat: I'll coordinate community channels (Discourse/Github Discussions) and schedule the Hacknight workshop repo issues as exercises. also volunteer to run office hours 1h after the live event.
nina: Nice. Assignments: omar = write HowTos; leigh = benchmark assets; taylor = landing + routing + UTMs; pat = community ops + office hours. deliverables due in 2w for first draft, final by week 4.
webhook-bot: reminder: repo "oss-quickstart" CI job #124 failed on lint at 1793509000 UTC. patch before publishing.
omar: noted, I'll open PRs for the HowTos and link the tutorial branches.
leigh: benchmark numbers from my local run: p95=95ms (gpu), throughput ~320 tok/s. will upload CSV and PNG to assets dir. command used: ```bash
./tools/run_bench --model gpt-small --batch 16 --seq 128
```
taylor: landing copy draft: "Ship faster with the OSS Quickstart: 3 tutorials, 1 reference app, realtime benchmark." Will A/B subject lines: "Hands-on Hacknight: OSS Quickstart" vs "Build a refapp in 30 mins".
pat: I'll prep three discussion threads for each tutorial and a community leaderboard for participants. small prizes? stickers + early beta access.
nina: agreed on prizes. next steps: everyone push a PR with draft content by EOD next Friday. I'll compile calendar invites and a brief agenda. :sparkles:
